fact: Understanding is another function of the mind, and it is a step forward in the school of knowledge
Paul prayed for understanding in Ephesians 1:17-18, asking that God 'may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened'
Paul's prayer continues 'that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints'
Whereas knowledge gets the information across, understanding unravels the things behind it
In Acts chapter 8, Phillip asked the Ethiopian eunuch 'Understandest thou what thou readest?', cited as Acts 8:30
Phillip's question is glossed as 'Do you know what you're reading?'
The eunuch replied that he was reading from Isaiah 53
The eunuch said the passage was talking about a sheep led to the slaughter that openeth not its mouth
When Phillip finally asked whether he understood it, the eunuch replied 'No, I don't', which is the point of the episode
There is a great difference between knowledge and understanding
Proverbs 13:15 is quoted: 'Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard'
What good understanding does is to make you outstanding in your quest in life
Your depth of understanding determines how outstanding you become in life
Understanding results when you process knowledge with commitment
Knowledge is processed by asking what it offers you, how to get at the benefits it carries, and what is required of you to tap into the virtues of the information
With those questions you find your coast getting enlarged as understanding begins to dawn on you
It is one thing to have a vision and another to understand the vision, and it is how much understanding of that vision you have that determines the outstanding nature of your accomplishment
Ecclesiastes 4:9 is cited for 'Two are better than one', used to illustrate that collaboration enhances outcomes
For some, their condition in marriage is worse than before they got married, making them conclude they were better off before the two came together
God's Word is not a lie when two are not better than one; it is the people's application of it that is wrong, because they have not taken time to understand what it takes to make two better than one
When understanding comes in and the wisdom of correct application takes its place, then you find two actually becoming better than one
When you are baptized in the Holy Ghost, the Bible says the Spirit of the Lord will make you of a quick understanding
Knowledge is limited to what you can see, touch, smell and feel, but understanding goes beyond that
Isaiah 11 says of Jesus 'and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears', which shows where knowledge stops
The Spirit of the Lord making Jesus of quick understanding means He goes beyond seeing and hearing, because the Holy Spirit grants Him unusual access into the deep things of God
When you are redeemed you have the Holy Spirit, whose mission is to quicken your understanding and make you supernaturally smart in grasping the issues of life and the things of God
Understanding is what helps you to tap into the benefits of knowledge and to actualize all you have acquired through knowledge
Some have insight on divine healing but lack the understanding to walk in its reality, and that limitation in understanding limits their results
Almost every Christian has some bits of knowledge of prosperity, but not everyone is walking in the reality of it, because their understanding on the issue is limited
Meditation is what processes knowledge into understanding: when you subject knowledge to intense meditation, the end product is understanding
Psalm 119:96-100 is quoted of David, including 'O how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day'
David said 'Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me'
David said 'I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation'
David said 'I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts', which the author glosses as pondering on them
Meditation was David's access to understanding, and meditation is defined as the mental processing of knowledge into understanding
A very startling study is cited: only 5 per cent of the human populace think, 15 per cent think they are thinking, and the remaining 80 per cent would rather die than think
Understanding does not just drop; it comes through a conscious process of meditation, that is staying mentally focused on an issue until the nitty gritty of it are unfolded to you
